whenToUse: AI work that goes through several steps, such as finding, organizing, and writing.
Jobs that take tens of seconds or more.
whenNotToUse: Short answers done in one go (use a thinking indicator).
Dozens of steps would make the list long (summarize them).
There's no need to expose the internal process.
accessibility: The ol list is aria-live, so step changes are announced.
Each step adds Done, In progress, or Waiting in words.
Icons and connecting lines are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
The spinner stops with reduced motion.
